scripts.build: tsc && echo '<!DOCTYPE html><html><body>agent-server</body></html>' > dist/index.html && mkdir -p output/bin && cp -r dist/* output/bin/ && cp -r node_modules output/bin/ && cp package.json output/bin/ && npm run build:skills
scripts.build:skills: skills add larksuite/cli -s lark-doc -s lark-im -s lark-contact -s lark-base -s lark-drive -s lark-sheets -s lark-shared -y --copy && cp -r .agents/skills output/bin/.agent-skills
